idea-plugin.description:
Send references to selected code directly to the active JetBrains Terminal tab.

Select code, press the shortcut, and paste a reference into the current terminal session without switching windows or typing the file path manually.

How to use

  1. Select any code in the editor.
  2. Press Ctrl+Alt+K (macOS: ⌘⌥K), or right-click → Send to Terminal.
  3. The active Terminal tab receives a reference such as @src/UserService.kt#L42-58.
  4. The Terminal tool window is brought forward; the reference is pasted but not submitted.

You can also send files and folders: select them in the Project view (⌘1 / Alt+1) and use the same shortcut or context-menu action.

The reference is pasted without pressing Enter, so you can review it or add more input before submitting.

How to change the shortcut

  1. Open Settings → Keymap.
  2. Search for Send to Terminal.
  3. Double-click → Add Keyboard Shortcut → press your keys → OK.

Requirements

  • The built-in JetBrains Terminal plugin must be enabled.
  • Works in JetBrains IDEs version 2026.2 or newer: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, Android Studio.
  • Supports Remote Development (JetBrains Gateway / JetBrains Client); install the plugin on the remote IDE.
